name: MindSift
description: Notes, tasks and shared lists with quick capture, an outliner, kanban and an MCP server.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database, uploaded images and audio, backups and the keys MindSift makes on first start (secrets.key encrypts hidden values in notes). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: MindSift web app, published on host as 6710

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: BASE_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6710, or use your https domain. Live updates only work from this address, and email links use it.
